svg.text: Survival Sim: the Brain as a Neural Network
Each circle is a neuron, each line a weight. Only a sample is drawn: the real network has 414,542 weights. ⋮ marks the neurons not shown.
links to every neuron before it
Each neuron adds up its inputs × weights, then applies ReLU (negatives become 0). The ACTOR's 13 numbers become action chances (softmax); learning = adjusting the weights on the lines.
